description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows users to add a new shelf in a book tracking application. It manages user input, validation, and communicates with backend endpoints to save the shelf.

classes.name: ShelfModal
classes.description: React component class for the Shelf modal dialog, handling user input for shelf name, validation, and API communication.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the component state with the current value of the input field.

methods.name: submitShelf
methods.description: Validates the shelf name and sends a POST request to save the new shelf, updating the UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with input fields, buttons, and alert messages.
